events.title: Maleny Community Centre 2026 Annual General Meeting
events.description:
The AGM is an opportunity to reflect on the past year, celebrate our achievements, and look ahead to the future of the Centre.

We are delighted to welcome Dave Southern as our guest speaker. Dave led the team that designed and hand-carved the magnificent timber entrance doors to the Main Hall—one of the Centre’s most recognisable and treasured features. He will share insights into his artistic journey, his work as a woodcarver, and the inspiration behind his craft. Dave will also assist in a special unveiling.

We hope you can join us for what promises to be an enjoyable and inspiring morning as we celebrate our Centre, its history, and the people who have contributed to its success.

Date: Wednesday 30th September 2026
Time: 10.30am
Venue: Verandah Room, Maleny Community Centre

events.title: Sunny Coast Women Solopreneurs: Your offsite 2026-27 strategic planning day
events.description:
Your FY results are in so it’s officially Strategic Planning Season!

Imagine being in the room with equally motivated like-minded individuals ready to make this financial year their best yet. While you work on your own strategy and performance goals, you get to meet, mingle, make new friends and swap ideas. We make it easy, fun, engaging and energising.

What’s in store:

  • Celebrate the wins of the last 12 months with other people who understand the solopreneur journey

  • The opportunity to check in on your own ambitions as well as where you want to take your enterprise

  • Future-casting with our Futurist & Strategy Keynote

  • Special Guest Speaker on self-leadership

  • Special Guest Speaker on financial sustainability

  • Clear direction and mission for the next 12 months specific to your business

Food & Fun

  • Arrival morning tea and opportunity to network with other participants

  • Optional lunch to mingle with other participants after the workshop

Take-aways

  • Personal workbook

  • Strategy-on-a-page
